story.title: Story 1: Pull and Status on the Record

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up convergence review for SV-01-PULL-STATUS-001. I checked the implementor receipt, the touched seam/thread-view/test files, reran the required gates, and reran the prior background SDK production-path probes that originally exposed the bug.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved. `runWithThreadTouchSuppressed` now suppresses thread-touch announcements while preserving poke/view config (`src/shared/context.ts:117-129`), and `threadView.pull`/`status` wrap their bodies in that scope (`src/domains/thread-view/index.ts:84-85`, `src/domains/thread-view/index.ts:181-182`). The new background regression test uses a real background SDK with pending work and asserts unchanged state, zero provider calls, byte-identical pulls, and repeated status (`test/view-pull.test.ts:485-526`). My focused probe confirmed the prior failure path is closed: pull work rows stayed 4→4 with 0 provider calls; status work rows stayed 4→4 with 0 provider calls and pending work visible; boundary-seeded two-pull result was byte-identical with matching hashes.

verified: AC-1.1 / TC-1.2: pull read-only/no provider/no queue interaction is covered in both manual and background SDK paths; focused background probe showed work rows 4→4 and provider captures 0.
AC-1.2 / TC-1.1: existing test verifies committed intake appears in record order and later intake appends.
AC-1.3 / TC-1.1: existing test verifies never-compacted pull returns tail-only meta with no band content and no error.
AC-1.5 / TC-1.4: existing tests verify boundary short/full rendering, ready-summary fallback, truncation fallback, and non-tool content full rendering.
AC-1.7 / TC-1.2: existing manual test and focused background boundary probe verify repeated pulls are byte-identical with no intervening intake, boundary movement, or compact.

AC-2.8 / TC-2.5: status fields and read-only behavior are covered, including the new background SDK pending-work leg; focused probe showed status work rows 4→4, provider captures 0, and pending derivations visible.
Definition of Done: structured stubs, zero-provider assertions, full-result hashing, array shape comments, and required gates are present and green.

gatesRun.command: focused background pull/status/two-pull production-path probe via pnpm exec tsx -e

additionalObservations: `pnpm run green-verify` passed with 244 default tests and immutability OK; `pnpm run verify-all` passed with 271 tests including process suites.

No fake adapter, placeholder branch, or non-real runtime path was found in the fix. The suppression scope is production code used by the SDK thread-view read path, and the regression test goes through `createSdk().threadView.pull/status` against real temp thread files.
